task_description: Frontend UI/UX redesign of the Perpustakaan Digital web app: make the app show LOGIN first and gate the catalog behind authentication; restyle the entire UI to a strictly black-and-white (monochrome) elegant theme; render a self-contained cover image for every book; and replace accidental/implicit actions with explicit buttons plus confirmation steps and clear feedback so the app is easier and more predictable to use. Frontend-only (plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS), no backend contract changes.

verification.summary: No build step (static site). node --check passes on all three JS assets (api.js, nav.js, config.js). style.css contains only grayscale/black/white values (no blue/green/red/amber). index.html gates on Auth.requireLogin() and now wraps the catalog bootstrap in `if (Auth.isLoggedIn())` so anonymous visitors fire no stray API requests before redirect; every book renders a bookCoverSvg cover. UI.confirm is wired into borrow (index), return (my-loans), and delete book/category + edit-save (admin) with no native confirm() remaining; each action has loading/disabled state and success/error feedback. Static server returns HTTP 200 for login/register/index/my-loans/admin. No automated test suite exists in the repo (per docs), so test_quality was assessed via manual code review of the new flows and confirmed correct. Semantic review verdict: APPROVED (v1); its two non-blocking findings (stray-request login gate, stacked-dialog Enter guard) were both fixed in commit 4b668e6. Docker build skipped (frontend-only change).
